# YOLOX runtime dependency

This vendored source provides the YOLOX package and `yolox-l` experiment used by FlowHMR for person detection. Upstream docs, tests, demos, and display assets are excluded from the runtime tree.

Upstream project: https://github.com/Megvii-BaseDetection/YOLOX

Retain the Apache-2.0 `LICENSE` when redistributing this source.
